criterion.calibration_limit: These are frozen empirical envelopes for subsequent aligned-seed evaluations, not physics tolerances and not an independent verdict on the calibration cohort.

measurement_contract.batch_size_dependence_rule: true iff a bound's aggregate pass or any held-out case pass status differs between measured sizes
measurement_contract.seed_alignment: each case's scalar seed is repeated exactly over the batch axis
measurement_contract.throughput_rung_call: each measured batch size calls the same acceptance entry point

repetition_stability.qualification: run-to-run variation is reported independently from batch-size variation and prevents interpreting one device run as a certificate
